name: dorsolateral prefrontal cortex
notes: ABC Atlas files it as DFC-10X. sea-ad-single-cell-profiling has both DLPFC/ (pre-2026) and PFC/ (2026 release; the bucket README says the DLPFC data moved there). Both are aliased here as the same anatomical region; that does NOT mean the files in the two folders are the same data. A9 (Brodmann area 9) added 2026-11-22 on the bucket README's evidence: DREAM is described as 'the MTG and DFC datasets' and holds SEAAD_A9_*; the old DLPFC files were 'moved from DLPFC/' into PFC/previous_objects/, where the SEAAD_A9_* files are.

name: head of caudate

name: extrastriate occipital cortex
notes: Added 2026-11-22. Not in the ABC multiregion release. SEA-AD's own code: the neuropathology table full-tabular-data/V1C-ESOC_all-values_aibs-ids_20250922.csv. DHBA id and name confirmed against the Allen DHBA ontology (structure graph 16): ESOC is the sibling of V1C under occipital neocortex (Ocx) and contains V2 (area 18) and peristriate cortex (area 19). The neuropathology slides split it from V1 as 'Higher-Order-Visual' vs 'Primary-Visual' subregions.
